item.name: Serving_Tongs
item.description: Small stainless-steel food-service tongs used to hand out cheese servings.
item.readyBeforeUse: Each tong is clean, sanitized, air-dry, and opens and closes freely.
item.readyForNextPerson: During service, tongs remain clean and do not touch guests. After service, each tong is washed, rinsed, sanitized, air-dry, and stored.
item.ifNotReady: Do not serve with a dirty or damaged tong. Tell the Food Lead.
